cards.headline: Insurance reform: Insurers’ low capacity, offshore cover cost aviation, maritime N500b yearly
cards.what_happened: Nigerian insurers' low underwriting capacity and reliance on offshore cover are reported to cost the aviation and maritime sectors about N500 billion yearly. The report points to insurance reform as a way to retain premiums onshore. The article's text is limited to its headline, so further detail is not available.

cards.headline: Enugu seals four illegal private hospitals, warns against unsafe medical practices
cards.what_happened: Enugu State authorities sealed four private hospitals operating illegally and warned against unsafe medical practices. The action targets facilities found operating without proper authorisation. No further details on the operators or ownership were reported.
